notes.title: Big Changes and I need your Feedback
notes.content:
Welcome back to the Rogue Jungle Playtest,

This Update has some huge changes:

-> The Dungeons are now procedurally generated
-> A new Progression System (inspired by Hades)
-> Changed a lot of variables in the Enemy-Difficulty-Scaling

Please give me your Feedback how you like these new changes!

notes.title: Second Playtest
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Second Public Playtest for Rogue Jungle is NOW LIVE!!!

Keep in mind that the game is still WIP and has a long way to go since its only me working on it solo. Its my first time developing a Roguelike, so I really need your feedback to make the game as good as possible!

You can help me by filling out this feedback form after playing:
[url=https://forms.gle/v14Yg3hk4BCUmnZi9]Link to the Google Form for Feedback[/url]

This Game version has no meta progress and only 1 Pre-Built dungeon, but Im working on a Steam Demo at the moment with more Content. 

It would be really helpful to get your feedback on the game concept and weapon-merge mechanic!

If you have already played a Test Version before, please make sure to delete the Save Data to prevent any bugs and problems with the new Version. You can find the Game Data here:

C:\Users\"Your Username"\AppData\LocalLow\Zoroarts\Rogue Jungle

You can just delete the whole "Rogue Jungle" Folder (if it exists) and start off fresh and new :)

Thank you so much and have a fantastic day!

notes.title: Playtest 2 Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for the great Feedback so far! I spent the last days, after the second Playtest, to build in small improvements that you requested:

-> Full Controller Support
-> Game works on all resolutions now (No weird behaviour for wide-screens)
-> Vampire Upgrade: Heal Chance from 20% to 5%
-> Bouncing Arrows: Now the arrows only bounce off walls with 30% chance

Please keep in mind that the game is early in development (3 monts), so I need your feedback to make an enjoyable and fun game! ^^

Feel free to wishlist and give me your honest Feedback after playing:
[url=https://forms.gle/5eNAqN4gCHF8zDHA7]Feedback-Form[/url]

If you are a Content Creator, please feel free to upload a video or stream the game and share your first impression with me ^^

Thank you and have a great weekend!

Best regards,
Mateo [ZoroArts]
